newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures end higher, prices recoup losses.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures end higher, prices recoup losses.

text.p: NYCE frozen concentrated orange juice futures corrected recent losses and closed firmer in robust volume.
Floor sources cited local and speculative buying, which triggered stops and lifted prices to the high of 99.90 basis spot-January.
The contract settled at 100.35, up 2.70, having ranged from 100.50 to 97.64. The contract pierce resistance at 100.00. The back months finished 3.45 to 2.80 higher.
"The sentiment has been so bearish; I'm surprised the market could eke out a rally like this," an analyst said. "But most people are on the sidelines waiting for the delivery period to be over."
The last notice day for November FCOJ is Thursday, November 21.
The November contract expired Friday at 107.30 cents per pound, off 4.95, and the November/January spread went out at 9.65, with open interest in the front month at 2,509 lots.
Nearby support was pegged at 96.80 in January.
Temperatures across the Florida citrus belt are expected to remain below normal for the remainder of the week, but are not expected to fall low enough to damage fruit.
